Therefore, the Router's visual observation of 'muddy/indistinct' fusion overrides the expert's mask confidence. The 'texture_anomaly' (severity 2) on yellow spots is also valid; AI often fails to replicate the subsurface scattering/wetness of the base skin on colored patterns. The Perceptual Quality Auditor only found slight compression, missing these structural/textural issues, confirming the need to prioritize the Router's direct visual audit for artifacts.
